views.constrains: The primary L-shaped profile defining the object's width (X) and height (Z). The vertical leg forms the mounting face, and the horizontal leg forms the hook arm.
The depth (Y) of the object. The uniform rectangular shape indicates a constant thickness (depth) extruded from the front profile.

parts.name: L_wall_hook
parts.description: Single solid object with an L-shaped cross-section.

features.name: L_profile
features.description: The 2D L-shaped outline defining the front face of the hook.

features.name: extrusion_depth
features.description: The uniform thickness of the hook, derived from the top view.

dimensions.size_provenance: measured ink spans x authoritative max dimension

uncertainties: Exact thickness (Y-axis) is visually estimated from the top view aspect ratio relative to the front view width.
Exact leg lengths and thicknesses of the L-shape are estimated from pixel coordinates.
generation_notes: The object is interpreted as a simple extrusion of the L-shaped front profile. The top view confirms a uniform depth. The geometry is regularized to clean lines and sharp corners suitable for 3D printing.

unresolved_constraints: Exact depth value (Y) is estimated based on visual aspect ratio.

user_intent.description: L wall hook extruded from front profile

multi_view_contract: All source views constrain one shared physical object; never instantiate views as separate geometry.
cutout_policy: Closed internal profiles are subtractive through-cutouts unless explicitly classified otherwise.
